arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Edge case: Pattern ends with specific whitespace characters
tests = [
    ('{:w}', 'hello   ', 'Whitespace type field'),
    ('{:s}', '   ', 'Whitespace-only input for :s type'),
    ('text\\t', 'text\\t', 'Tab character literal'),
    ('text\\n', 'text\\n', 'Newline character literal'),
]

print('Testing whitespace-specific patterns:')
for pattern, input_str, desc in tests:
    try:
        r = parse.parse(pattern, input_str)
        print(f'{desc}: {r}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{desc}: ERROR - {e}')
"
